name: DeepSeek Quota Bar
description: Draggable transparent balance card for the DSH web GUI: a blood-bar of remaining balance vs the month-opening snapshot, today/month spend (official platform data when the token is configured), and current session cost.
descriptionZh: DSH Web 右下角可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条，今日与本月使用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据），以及当前对话费用。
